title: ✈️ Super 8 by Wyndham Sarnia — Jul 19, 2026
itinerary_text:
## 🚗 ROAD TRIP OVERVIEW

*   **Route:** Brampton to Windsor (via ON-401 W), then Windsor to Sarnia (via ON-402 W).
*   **Total Distance:** Approximately 350 km (Brampton to Sarnia).
*   **Total Drive Time:** ~3 hours and 45 minutes (driving time only).
*   **Halfway/Rest Stop:** Your requested stop in Windsor serves as the perfect break. Since the total drive is under 4 hours, no additional overnight halfway stop is required.
*   **Group Logistics:** All activities and dining are selected for a party of 4.

---

## Day 1 – Sunday, July 19, 2026: The Journey & Arrival
*   **09:00 AM:** Depart Brampton.
*   **12:30 PM – 02:30 PM:** Stop in **Windsor**. 
    *   **Activity:** Walk along the **Windsor Sculpture Park** on the waterfront for relaxation and fresh air.
    *   **Lunch:** *The Loose Goose* (Downtown Windsor). Great casual vibe, perfect for groups of 4.
*   **02:30 PM – 04:30 PM:** Drive from Windsor to Sarnia (approx. 1 hour 45 mins).
*   **05:00 PM – 06:00 PM:** Check into **Super 8 by Wyndham Sarnia**.
*   **07:00 PM:** Dinner at **Big Fish Steak & Lounge**. Upscale but accessible, great for a group celebration.

---

## Day 2 – Monday, July 20, 2026: Adventure & Relaxation
*   **10:00 AM:** Breakfast at **Alternate Grounds Dockside**. Located right on the water.
*   **12:00 PM – 03:00 PM:** **Adventure/Outdoors:** Visit **Canatara Park**. It features a beach, trails, and a petting farm. Great for group photos and relaxation.
*   **04:00 PM – 06:00 PM:** **Shopping:** Visit **Lambton Mall** for some retail therapy.
*   **07:00 PM:** Dinner at **Stokes Inland**. A local favorite with plenty of space for four people.

---

## Day 3 – Tuesday, July 21, 2026: Local Flavors & Leisure
*   **10:00 AM:** Coffee and pastries at **Coffee Culture**.
*   **12:00 PM:** **Group Activity:** Visit the **St. Clair River District**. Walk the trails near the Bluewater Bridge for incredible views of the border.
*   **02:00 PM:** Late lunch at **Tin Fiddler Pub**. Known for great pub food and atmosphere.
*   **04:00 PM – Onwards:** Free time. Relax at the hotel pool or head back to the beach for sunset.

---

## 🏨 Hotel Recommendations
**Super 8 by Wyndham Sarnia ON**
*   **Room Configuration:** I recommend booking **two rooms with two Queen beds** each to ensure maximum comfort and privacy for 4 adults.
*   *Note:* The hotel is located conveniently near the highway for your departure on the 22nd.

---

## 📊 TRIP SUMMARY (Per Person & Group)

| Category | Cost Per Person | Group Total (x4) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Hotel (3 Nights)** | $225 | $900 |
| **Food & Drink** | $250 | $1,000 |
| **Gas (Est. round trip)** | $40 | $160 |
| **Activities/Misc** | $60 | $240 |
| **TOTAL** | **$575** | **$2,300** |

*Note: Budget is estimated based on economy standards. Fuel costs are based on current average prices and vehicle efficiency. Taxes and gratuities for meals are included in the per-person food budget.*

---

**Agent Tips for the Group:**
1.  **Check-in:** You mentioned checking in by 6 or 7 PM. Since you depart Windsor at 2:30 PM, you will easily arrive in Sarnia by 4:30 PM, putting you well within your goal.
2.  **Departure:** Remember checkout is July 22 at 11:00 AM. Ensure everyone has their belongings packed the night before to facilitate an easy exit.
